author: Thomas Keightley
description: "The Fairy Mythology" by Thomas Keightley is a comprehensive exploration of folklore and beliefs surrounding fairies from various cultures, written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This work delves into how fairy traditions and superstitions have been interwoven into the mythologies of numerous countries, revealing their origins, characteristics, and significance in the human imagination.

authorInfo.bio:
Thomas Keightley (1789–1872) wrote The Fairy Mythology
Illustrative of the Romance and Superstition of Various Countries. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
